sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: US studio Lawson Fenning looked to Japan's 1960s Metabolism design movement when designing this seating range, which features a low, grounded sofa and chairs. "Bosque started with this idea of furniture as built form – pieces that feel grounded, almost architectural, but still really liveable," said Lawson Fenning co-founder and chief design officer The post Bosque seating by Lawson Fenning appeared first on Dezeen .
